review_notes.detail: All 36 A1 card portions and 72 printed input terminals were checked against enlarged native TIFF crops. Their literal fields match the source, with no unreadable characters.
The enlarged RT621 footer was read directly from the original TIFF: four printed columns with 9, 9, 9 and 1 entries. The machine title identifies P.N. 2585945 and BLK. BZ.

BS5M and BC7M location-prefix glyphs are damaged in the original gray TIFF. Same-page B/E/F comparison rules out F but does not securely distinguish B from E. Each unresolved cell is � in the TXT; A1 suggests B but is not used to silently restore missing native print. Independent proof/report: tmp/ald-text/rt/high/prefix_RT621/independent original gray prefix findings.json. Scan neighbors: RT601 before, RT625 after in original order.

RT621 uses the T-register two-bit page grid. The top AQ/AR boxes and bottom BQ/BR boxes were compared with native source bank crops; the right-hand output labels occupy their own blank-separated margin columns.
AS5E and BS5M are printed OR gates with distinct upper and lower inputs. AJ/BJ feed the upper inputs and AP/BP feed the lower inputs on separate stems.

The four T06AA left/right pairs were traced separately. AQ G10 continues to +PADDL 62; BQ G03 rises on c92 from row54 to +PADDL 63 on row47, crossing its upper-output/BK-upper row52 without a diamond; AR J11 descends on c87 and bends along row38 then c199 into +SADDL 06 on row36, crossing -ST BIT 62 at row37 without a diamond; BR G05 continues to +SADDL 07. Native proofs: low/independent/RT621/BQ G03 vertical complete native.png and SADDL06 bend tight native.png.
The -DATA KEY 62 TO ST top line, with PX211AF4 cross-reference, bends into AG G08. The middle -DATA KEY 63 TO ST line, with PX211AP4 cross-reference, bends into BG D10.

RT621 source crops were used for port positions, junction diamonds and right-side output labels. The +SADDL 06 right rule is the AR J11 output; +PADDL 63 is the BQ G03 output. Their crossings with adjacent storage/control nets have no source diamond and remain separate.
